backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor placeholder for backend canister.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features to source files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing prewritten summaries of key frontend source files.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base-layer CSS defining color tokens, dark mode variables, and global element styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app with navigation, hero banner, sections, static assets via getAssetPath, and footer with live URL.
frontend/src/components/LiveUrlFooter.ts: React footer component displaying the site origin with a clipboard copy button and success indicator.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages backend actors based on Internet Identity authentication state.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Authentication context and provider for managing Internet Identity login, identity state, and AuthClient setup.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind-based global stylesheet with warm neutral color palette, typography, and scrolling behavior.
frontend/src/lib/assetPaths.ts: Utility for constructing BASE_URL‑aware static asset paths to support varied deployment locations.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry script initializing React, React Query, Internet Identity provider, and global styles.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, container settings, animations, fonts, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s current state, requirements, features, known issues, and architectural notes for building and fixing the business website.
